## Schengen visa application for P1

The trade fair runs from **8 to 13 March 2027** in Munich. Enter your actual Schengen arrival and departure dates in B28 and B29.

**B01 · Surname**

RAGHUNATHAN

**B02 · Surname at birth or former family names**

NEEDS-YOU

Check whether you have a birth surname or former family name to enter.

**B03 · Given names**

VIKRAM

ANAND

Enter the given names together in the order and spelling shown in your passport. Include the middle name if it appears among the passport’s given names.

**B04 · Date of birth**

22/11/1983

After substitution, write the date in day-month-year order by hand if needed.

**B05 · Place of birth**

PUNE, MAHARASHTRA

|---|---|
| B20 · Residence outside country of nationality | Tick **Yes**. Document type is **UK residence permit**. Permit number is **NEEDS-YOU**. Expiry date is **NEEDS-YOU**. |
| B21 · Current occupation | Software engineer |
| B22 · Employer | NEEDS-YOU — employer name, address and telephone number |
| B23 · Purpose of journey | Tick **Business**. |
| B24 · Additional information | Attending a trade fair in Munich, Germany, from 8 to 13 March 2027. |
| B25 · Main destination | Germany. Any additional Schengen destinations are NEEDS-YOU if applicable. |
| B26 · First entry | NEEDS-YOU — the first Schengen Member State you will enter on your itinerary. |
| B27 · Number of entries | NEEDS-YOU — select the number of entries you are requesting. |
| B28 · Arrival | NEEDS-YOU — intended date you enter the Schengen area. |
| B29 · Departure | NEEDS-YOU — intended date you leave the Schengen area. |
| B30 · Previous fingerprints | Tick **Yes**. Enter **2023** if the form accepts a year alone. Leave the exact date blank if unknown. Enter the visa sticker number privately if known. |
| B31 · Entry permit for final destination | Leave blank unless applicable. If applicable, NEEDS-YOU — issuing authority, valid-from date and expiry date. |
| B32 · Inviting person or accommodation | NEEDS-YOU — inviting person’s surname and given name, or the name of your hotel or other accommodation. |
| B33 · Contact details | NEEDS-YOU — address, email and telephone number for the person or accommodation in B32. |
| B34 · Inviting company or organisation | If applicable, NEEDS-YOU — name and address of the inviting company or organisation. |
| B35 · Inviting company contacts | If B34 applies, NEEDS-YOU — contact person’s surname, given name, address, telephone and email, plus the organisation’s telephone number. |
| B36 · Travel and living costs | Tick **by a sponsor**. Select the field 30 or 31 option if your employer is named there. Otherwise select **other** and enter the employer’s name, **NEEDS-YOU**. The means of support are **NEEDS-YOU** — tick the boxes that match what your employer is covering. |
| B37–B38 · Person filling in the form | Leave blank when you complete your own application. |
| B39 · Place and date | NEEDS-YOU — enter the place and date of signing. |
| B40 · Signature | NEEDS-YOU — sign the applicant field yourself. Leave the parental authority or legal guardian signature blank if inapplicable. |
